commands.purpose: Verify W4-015 checklist items C01-C07 on causal wave domains and membership contracts
Generate validation artifact wave_domain_validation.json on validation split

requirement_evidence.notes: Exact 64-step prefix (384 fixed dims, lower==upper==anchor[:, 64:]) and 384 free tail dims around center.
Constant continuation baseline center[..., 64:] = anchor[..., -1:] strictly observed; no lookahead.
Domain identity embeds anchor_raw_sha256, anchor_norm_sha256, prefix_sha256, step_idx, recording_id, tail budgets.
Independent checks for bit-exact prefix matching, stream continuity (step t+1, same recording_id), and tail containment.
Exposes same-center full-box control with 768 free coordinates. Note: degenerate coordinate box does not claim correlation preservation.
Evaluates H02 ramp counterexample and rejects zero/negative/infinite budgets fail-closed.
Evaluated 50 consecutive validation pairs without test set contamination; measured displacement and membership rates.

scientific_dispositions.evidence: 100% (50/50) of consecutive pairs in the validation split have bit-exact prefix match anchor[..., 64:] == query[..., :64].
Natural sensor signals show non-zero tail displacement (mean L2: 5.58, median: 0.78), requiring budget delta >= 0.1 for non-zero membership.

limitations: Causal wave proposal contract is strictly one-step (t -> t+1). Multi-step horizon expansion requires inductive compositions not covered by this task.
